answer: The ledge index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1303 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tundra. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the river queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The bill scales 50 fold, not the vote. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
